comparison.objective: Candidate removes four insert tangs; record unlocks an over-centre strut at its knee and stows a radiator panel.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel placement, hammering, and fragment pickup; record requires mechanism unlocking, controlled panel folding, and placement on supports.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures, contained tangs, and undamaged retained inserts; record requires the panel folded onto its rest pads and released. No specs provide further tolerances.
comparison.reason: Over-centre linkage release and panel stowage do not test fracture or recovery of sacrificial metal features.
